title: Interactive/Informative - Would highly recommend!
quote: I have attended two courses with Martin now: 1. Embracing change; and 2. Professional Business Communication The latter of which was a virtual training course due to the Covid-19 pandemic. On both occasions I have found the sessions to be very interesting and interactive. I can be shy when speaking up in front of people but Martin is a great listener and makes you feel comfortable. He is intuitive and is able to expand on anything you are finding difficult to explain/understand. I felt that Martin was able to tailor the courses to my role as a secretary and was able to demonstrate what we could take away from each course. Martin followed up on both occasions with slides from the courses and asked if we had any questions. I would definitely recommend these sessions!
author: Abigail Brown
subject: Professional Business Communication
